text_a: Pick list prints aisles in reverse order. Warehouse pick list sorts aisles from last to first since the 3.6 update, so pickers walk the long way.
text_b: Reverse aisle order on pick list. After updating to 3.6 our printed pick list starts at the last aisle and ends at the first one. Pickers in the warehouse are complaining.

text_a: Minibar charges added to wrong room. Housekeeping enters minibar items and the guests next door find them on their bill at checkout.
text_b: Spa calendar shows no free times. Guests see an empty calendar for the spa although the therapists have plenty of openings this week.

text_a: Webcam check fails on exam start page. Students on the exam start page get "camera not found" although the webcam works in other programs.
text_b: Exam will not start, says camera not found. My webcam is fine in video calls, but the check on the exam start page fails each time. I tried two browsers.

text_a: My cycling workouts show a flat line for heart rate. On runs the graph moves up and down as expected, but on the bike the watch gives one straight value the whole time.
text_b: Heart rate graph flat during cycling workouts. The watch records a flat heart rate line for cycling workouts, while running workouts look normal.

text_a: Playback speed resets every time. My chosen speed of 1.5 goes back to normal whenever the next show begins.
text_b: Episodes download over mobile data. With wifi only turned on the podcast app still fetches new shows on my data plan.

text_a: Scheduled campaign sends in UTC instead of local time. Newsletter campaigns scheduled for 9:00 go out at 9:00 UTC and ignore the account time zone.
text_b: Newsletter went out three hours early. I scheduled my campaign for 9:00 local time, and the send log says 9:00 UTC. Time zone in my account is set correctly.

text_a: Customer export contains deleted customers. The nightly file still includes people who were deleted years ago.
text_b: New customers missing from export. Anyone added today only appears in the file after the job runs the next night.

text_a: Fuel report counts diesel litres twice. For fleet vans that fill up at two stations on one day, the monthly fuel report adds the diesel litres twice.
text_b: Our diesel numbers in the fuel report look doubled. Vans with two fill-ups per day show far more litres than the receipts say, so the monthly totals for the fleet are useless.

text_a: Prescription refill button greyed out after 30 days. The refill button stays greyed out for prescriptions older than 30 days, although they are valid for six months.
text_b: Cannot refill my prescription in the app. The refill button is grey. My doctor says the prescription is valid for six months, and it was issued about 40 days ago.

text_a: Class announcements arrive with no sender name. Parents receive announcements from a blank sender and many of them go straight to junk.
text_b: Quiz shuffle marks correct answers wrong. With shuffle enabled the marking compares against the original order, so good students lose points.

text_a: Game crashes on trophy screen after chapter 6 boss. Beating the chapter 6 boss crashes to desktop as soon as the trophy screen appears.
text_b: crash after chapter 6 boss. killed the boss, trophy screen started to show and then the game crashed back to desktop. happened 3 times now, i cant get past chapter 6.

text_a: Valve does not close when watering schedule is over. Our greenhouse was flooded this morning. The irrigation program ended at 6 but the valve on zone 3 stayed open for hours.
text_b: Irrigation valve stays open after schedule ends. Zone 3 keeps watering long after the irrigation schedule has finished, and the controller log shows no close command.

text_a: Last minute sales appear tomorrow. Our end of day figures are always slightly short, and each morning begins with a small surplus nobody can explain.
text_b: Nightly aggregation misplaces events near midnight. Records stamped 23:59 land in the following day's totals because of an off by one in the bucket logic.

text_a: Hint text shown in wrong language. French users see the password hint in English on the signup form.
text_b: Profile page keeps old mail address after change. The new address works for login but the profile still displays the previous one to users.

text_a: Allergy note not printed on kitchen ticket. Allergy notes entered by the waiter appear on the till screen but never print on the kitchen ticket.
text_b: Kitchen never sees allergy notes. Our waiter typed a nut allergy into the order, and the printed ticket in the kitchen did not include it. This is dangerous, please look at the ticket printing.

text_a: Font menu covers page counter. In the reader the font menu stays open on top of the counter until the book is closed.
text_b: Highlights lost on ebook sync. Passages I marked on the tablet are gone after syncing with my phone.

text_a: Invoice PDF missing page numbers. Long invoices print without any numbering, so accounting cannot tell when a page is lost.
text_b: Invoice PDF missing company logo. Since the template change, generated invoices have an empty space where the logo belongs.

text_a: Artifact cleanup deletes release builds. The nightly retention job removes artifacts of tagged release builds after 30 days, although they are marked keep forever.
text_b: Our release build artifacts vanished. Builds tagged as releases were marked keep forever, but the retention job cleaned them up after 30 days. We can't roll back now.

text_a: Transfer limit message shows wrong currency. Exceeding the daily transfer limit shows an error with the limit in dollars on euro accounts.
text_b: Daily limit error says dollars. I have a euro account and tried a big transfer. The limit message says 5000 dollars, but the limit should be 5000 euros.

text_a: Config comments removed on save. Running `config set` strips all comments from the settings file that people maintain by hand.
text_b: Login subcommand asks for input twice. On Windows terminals the first answer to the prompt is dropped and you have to type it again.

text_a: Holiday bonus missing for part-time staff. Payroll run for December leaves out the bonus line for anyone on reduced hours, full-time employees are fine.
text_b: December payslip has no bonus for me. I work part-time and the holiday money is simply not there. Colleagues on a full contract all got it, can someone check?

text_a: Lab results sorted alphabetically. Doctors keep scrolling because the results tab sorts by test name rather than newest first.
text_b: Reminder text has old clinic phone number. The message template still lists the number from before the clinic moved.

text_a: My insurance claim stays In Review. I uploaded the documents you asked for two weeks ago and the status of my claim has not changed. Did the adjuster get them?
text_b: Claim status stuck on In Review after documents uploaded. After the customer uploads the missing documents, the claim stays In Review and adjusters are not notified.

text_a: Thermostat schedule runs weekday program on Saturday. The heating applies the weekday program on Saturdays since firmware 4.2.
text_b: Thermostat schedule screen hides Sunday. On the small display there is no room for the Sunday column, so it cannot be edited.

text_a: Cursor jumps to start of address field. Re-rendering on each keystroke while typing resets the caret position in the checkout form.
text_b: Letters come out scrambled when entering where I live. I am typing my street and the characters land in the wrong order, as if something keeps pushing me back.

text_a: Colleague's changes disappear when my laptop wakes up. We write the minutes together, and after I reopen it everything she typed in the meantime is gone.
text_b: Autosave overwrites shared document with stale copy. A laptop that reconnects after being offline pushes its old version over newer edits.

text_a: Ward claims to be full while places are free. Nurses see empty mattresses in room 4, but admissions are told nothing is available after people get moved upstairs.
text_b: Bed occupancy count wrong after transfers. Moving a patient decrements only the target ward, so the source keeps showing as occupied.

text_a: Search finds nothing for numbers. Typing a numeric order id returns no results although the order exists.
text_b: Search page returns results in wrong order. The page ignores relevance and lists everything by date, so the best match is buried.

text_a: Extra lessons on my printed schedule. When I download the timetable as PDF there is a Saturday with classes we do not have. In the portal view the week ends on Friday.
text_b: Timetable PDF shows Saturday lessons for every student. The exported timetable PDF adds a Saturday column with lessons from another group.

text_a: Priority dropdown shows duplicate entries. High appears twice in the list since the last migration of the tracker.
text_b: Comment box eats line breaks. Long comments on tickets lose all their paragraphs after saving.

text_a: Subtitle language resets on each episode. The streaming app forgets the selected subtitle language whenever the next episode starts.
text_b: Subtitles go back to English every episode. I choose Spanish as subtitle language, then the next episode starts and it has been reset. Very annoying when watching a whole season in the app.

text_a: Sticker machine stops every few weeks. The computer beside it runs out of space, IT frees some up, and shipping can carry on for another month.
text_b: Label host disk fills with spool files. It runs out of space because completed print jobs are never purged from the queue directory.

text_a: Payment page shows error for expired cards. The payment page displays a generic error instead of telling the customer that the card expired.
text_b: Payment page shows error after successful payment. Customers are told it failed even though the money was taken and the order exists.

text_a: Lost work because restore overwrote newer files. I ran backup restore on my project folder and it silently replaced files I edited today with older ones. There should at least be a prompt.
text_b: Restore command overwrites newer files without asking. `backup restore` replaces files that are newer than the backup and gives no warning or prompt.

text_a: Login screen forgets username. The saved name is empty each time the app opens, even with remember me turned on.
text_b: Login screen freezes on old phones. It stops responding for a minute on devices older than five years.

text_a: Group name cannot contain an apostrophe. Creating a chat group with an apostrophe in the name fails with a generic message.
text_b: Read times wrong just after midnight. Messages read a few minutes past midnight display the date from the day before.

text_a: Sensor reading shows zero after firmware update. The temperature sensor reports zero after firmware update 3.1 until it is restarted.
text_b: Sensor reading delayed after firmware update. Values reach the app about ten minutes behind real time since firmware update 3.1.

text_a: Legend is cut off in exported chart images. When I export a dashboard chart to PNG with many series, half of the legend is gone. On screen the chart is complete.
text_b: PNG export cuts off chart legend. Dashboard charts exported as PNG lose the right part of the legend when the chart has more than eight series.

text_a: Chat notification sound plays twice on Android. Each new message triggers the notification sound two times in a row on Android 14.
text_b: Chat notification sound missing for group mentions. Being mentioned in a group gives a banner but stays silent on Android 14.

text_a: Uploaded avatars appear cropped in directory. Faces are cut off at the forehead in the member directory when viewed on a phone.
text_b: Heads chopped off in our staff list. When I look colleagues up on my phone I only see chins and shoulders of everybody. On the big screen their pictures are complete.

text_a: You chased me for money I already paid. My transfer left on Tuesday, and on Wednesday came a letter saying that I owe you. Quite rude honestly.
text_b: Invoice reminder issued after settlement. Dunning job runs before the bank import, so accounts that paid yesterday still get flagged as overdue.

text_a: Candidate name loses accents after CV upload. Parsing an uploaded CV turns accented letters in the candidate name into question marks.
text_b: CV upload breaks names with accents. Applicants with é or ñ in their name show up with question marks after the CV is uploaded and parsed. Recruiters have to fix each candidate by hand.

text_a: Interview invites have no location. The calendar invite sent to candidates leaves the address empty even when the recruiter filled it in.
text_b: Job alert mail lists expired postings. Candidates get mails about jobs that were closed weeks ago.

text_a: Internet dies every night around two. All our laptops and phones lose the network for about a minute, then everything returns by itself.
text_b: Router drops clients during firmware check. Wifi disconnects for about a minute whenever the device looks for updates at 02:00.

text_a: My quadcopter flew past the no-go line. Reception was poor that afternoon and it happily left the permitted area without any warning to me.
text_b: Drone ignores geofence when GPS drifts. The aircraft crossed the configured boundary during a weak satellite fix and raised no warning.

text_a: Never receive my done badge. I watched all videos and passed each module test, yet it claims something remains, just below the top.
text_b: Course progress bar stalls at 95 percent. Completing every module still leaves the indicator short of finished for some learners.

text_a: Paying again on my way home. I have the yearly card for commuting, the morning ride is free, but in the evening the machine sells me a ticket.
text_b: Season pass not applied on return journey. The fare engine charges a single ticket for the second trip of the day for pass holders.

text_a: Extending a session charges the start fee again. Drivers pay the starting fee a second time when they add more minutes.
text_b: Parking receipt shows zone, not street. PDF receipts list a zone code, and my employer wants the street name for expenses.

text_a: Ordering allowed on public holidays. The app lets people order food on holidays when the restaurant is closed, and nobody cooks it.
text_b: Moving the map pin wipes delivery note. Dragging the pin on the order screen in the app removes whatever the customer wrote as a delivery note.

text_a: Old tills add a zero to scanned codes. Items are not found at the register because an extra leading zero gets added.
text_b: Note lost on transfer between shops. A note typed on a stock transfer never reaches the receiving shop.

text_a: Credit note numbering restarts every year. Accountants need one continuous sequence, but numbers start again from one each January.
text_b: Invoice due date ignores payment terms. Clients with 60 day terms receive invoices due in 30 days.

text_a: Low battery alert at 3am on brand new batteries. My smoke detector keeps sending this alert since updating to firmware 2.7. I replaced the batteries twice, it makes no difference.
text_b: Smoke detector sends false low battery alert. Detectors with new batteries report low battery every night around 3am after firmware 2.7.

text_a: Table loses sort order when paging. Moving to the next page resets the sorting chosen by the user.
text_b: Pie chart colors change on refresh. Each reload assigns different colors to the same categories on the page, which confuses readers.

text_a: Viewer role cannot see report totals. Users with the viewer role see empty cells in the totals row of every report.
text_b: Y axis rounds small values to zero. Charts with values below one draw a flat line because the axis labels use integer rounding.

text_a: Paid four times for one family ticket. We are two adults and two kids, and the museum website multiplied the price by four at the last step. Is that not the point of a family offer?
text_b: Family ticket charged per person at checkout. Museum family ticket is priced per person in the checkout total instead of one price for the group.

text_a: Attendance report will not download for large classes. For classes over 200 students the download stops with a server error.
text_b: Attendance report shows wrong totals for part-time students. Their percentage is calculated from the full-time schedule, so many look as if they skipped half the term.

text_a: Door refuses my QR code after arriving late. We did late check-in at 1am and the room key QR was rejected at the door lock. Reception had to let us in.
text_b: Room key QR code rejected after late check-in. Guests checking in after midnight get a QR code that the door lock rejects until morning.

text_a: Feedback survey closes a week early. The end date shown to students on the course page is one week later than the real closing date.
text_b: Student photo form rejects PNG files. The form accepts only JPG without saying so, and students get an unclear message.

text_a: Second author missing from search results. Catalogue records with two authors show only one name in the result list.
text_b: Membership renewal never finishes online. Members try to renew and the payment step keeps waiting until the session ends.

text_a: Deploy pipeline passes with missing secret. If the secret is absent the job prints a warning and still reports success, though nothing was deployed.
text_b: Deploy pipeline fails after secret rotation. When the secret is rotated the job keeps using the old value and fails at login.

text_a: Bus pass code unreadable in dark mode. Gate readers can't scan the inverted code when the phone is set to dark mode.
text_b: Trip planner routes through closed stations. Planned closures are not considered, so riders get journeys they cannot make on the phone app.

text_a: Getting 409 conflict updating a user with the same email. Our client sends the whole profile on PATCH /users, and if the email did not change the API answers 409.
text_b: PATCH /users returns 409 when email is unchanged. Sending the user's current email in a PATCH request gives 409 conflict, the uniqueness check does not exclude the user itself.

text_a: Salary advance request stuck on approval. Requests above 500 wait forever because the approver group for that amount is empty.
text_b: Expense photos stored sideways. Receipts photographed in portrait are saved rotated, and accounting has trouble reading the amounts.

text_a: Probe names swap after pairing. Adding a fifth soil probe changes the names of the existing ones in the list.
text_b: Humidity alarm cannot be muted. The alarm keeps ringing after being acknowledged in the greenhouse app.

text_a: Average rating in survey results is too low. We noticed that people who skipped the rating question count as a zero in the chart, so the average looks worse than it is.
text_b: Survey chart counts skipped answers as zero. In the results chart, respondents who skipped a rating question are counted as zero, which lowers the average.

text_a: Course video thumbnails show black frame. Lecturers choose a picture, but the list displays the first black frame of the video.
text_b: Slides download hidden for enrolled learners. Since the layout change the download option for lecture slides cannot be found.

text_a: Settings page goes blank after changing language. Choosing another language on the settings page leaves an empty screen until the user logs in again.
text_b: Blank settings page when I switch language. I picked German in the app settings and everything turned white. Logging out and back in brings the page back.

text_a: Key bindings lost when changing graphics mode. Controls go back to default after switching from windowed to fullscreen.
text_b: Invite link opens store page. Friends who click a multiplayer invite land on the store page instead of in my lobby.

text_a: Closed branches still listed in roster app. Staff see shifts for branches that shut down last year, and they ask who is working there.
text_b: Clock-in button disabled near shift start. It greys out during the five minutes before work begins, exactly when most staff arrive.

text_a: Voice message upload fails with error 413. Voice messages longer than two minutes fail with HTTP 413 on upload, the proxy limit seems too small.
text_b: Long voice messages won't send, error 413. Anything over about two minutes stops during upload and the chat shows error 413. Short voice notes are fine.

text_a: Order confirmation mail arrives twice. Customers get two copies for one order since the queue retry change.
text_b: Order confirmation mail shows wrong delivery date. It promises delivery a week earlier than the checkout page does.

text_a: Got an overdue mail after returning my books. I handed them in on Monday at the library desk and today an overdue notice arrived with a fine. My account history shows the return.
text_b: Overdue notice sent for books already returned. The library system mails an overdue notice even though the desk scanner logged the return two days earlier.

text_a: Test report timestamps lie in the future. Finished jobs appear to end tomorrow because the report formats local time as UTC.
text_b: Pipeline ignores skip flag in commit message. Commits carrying the skip flag still start a complete build and use up our minutes.

text_a: Travellers cannot finish registering. Anyone outside the country waits for that six digit code and nothing comes, so they give up on creating a profile.
text_b: Verification SMS never reaches roaming numbers. Signup stalls for users abroad because the one time code is not delivered outside the home network.

text_a: E412 on the vendor form. cant save bank details for a new vendor, it just shows error E412. removing the spaces from the IBAN made it work for me.
text_b: Saving vendor bank details fails with E412. Accounts staff get error E412 as soon as an IBAN containing spaces is entered on the vendor form.

text_a: Region chart takes a minute to draw. With the region view on, the dashboard spins for about a minute before anything appears.
text_b: Region chart shows numbers for wrong area. Selecting north on the dashboard displays the numbers for south.

text_a: Vaccination certificate has wrong logo. Certificates from the second branch carry the logo of the main practice.
text_b: Pet photo disappears after editing visit. Updating the visit record removes the picture from the animal's profile.

text_a: Smart plug forgets its name after power cut. The plug comes back as "new device" in the app each time the electricity returns.
text_b: Firmware update leaves thermostat clock at midnight. After each update the clock reads 00:00 and has to be set by hand in the app.

text_a: Quantity buttons dead on basket page. Customers press plus on the basket page and nothing changes for items that have a size option.
text_b: Shipping label prints without barcode. The courier rejects parcels because the printed label has an empty area where the barcode should be.

text_a: Plate number with hyphen rejected by parking app. Entering a licence plate with a hyphen gives "invalid plate" in the parking app, so those drivers cannot start a session.
text_b: Parking app refuses my car. My registration has a hyphen in the middle and I get invalid plate. If I leave that character out it accepts, but then the inspector cannot find my session.
